subscribers.destroy: IssueSubscriber.get(project, subscriber=subscriber_id, workspace, issue) -> delete -> 204. Route kwarg is subscriber_id (a USER id, not the row pk!).
subscribers.guards: get_permissions swap: subscribe/unsubscribe/subscription_status -> ProjectLitePermission; else ProjectEntityPermission
subscribers.list: 200 + ProjectMemberLiteSerializer over ACTIVE ProjectMembers (NOT subscribers! returns membership roster; D-25 PIDASHCONV-566 provides the serializer) (:52-57)
subscribers.subscribe: exists -> 400 {'message': 'User already subscribed to the issue.'}; else create(issue, subscriber=user, project) -> 201 + IssueSubscriberSerializer row (note: NO workspace kwarg — ProjectBaseModel.save backfills workspace from project)
subscribers.unsubscribe: IssueSubscriber.get(project, subscriber=user, workspace, issue) -> delete -> 204; missing -> 404 via handle_exception
